title: Evidence-Gated Bilingual RAG for Reliable Consumer Banking Search
abstract: arXiv:2610.22652v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Consumers often describe what they need rather than use the terminology found on a banking website. For example, a natural-language request ("a card for travel") may not share the keywords of the relevant product page, and the problem is harder in bilingual services, where the same intent may be expressed in Arabic or English. This paper presents an evidence-gated bilingual retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) framework for consumer banking search that operates entirely on local infrastructure. The framework combines structured web-content refinement, hybrid dense-lexical retrieval, intent-aware evidence selection, cross-encoder reranking, and a three-outcome Answer / Related Mismatch / No Answer decision mechanism. On 210 URL-labeled Arabic and English queries, the proposed approach improves Top-1 hit rate from 50.48% to 79.05% and MRR@5 from 0.571 to 0.797 over a hybrid baseline. A separate 26-case end-to-end evaluation achieved 69.2%

translated_title: 面向可靠消费银行搜索的证据门控双语RAG框架
translated_abstract: 消费者在描述自身需求时，往往不会使用银行网站上的专业术语。例如，一个自然语言请求（“一张用于旅行的卡”）可能与相关产品页面的关键词并不重合，而在双语服务中问题更加复杂，因为同一意图可能用阿拉伯语或英语表达。本文提出了一种面向消费银行搜索的证据门控双语检索增强生成（RAG）框架，该框架完全运行于本地基础设施之上。该框架结合了结构化网页内容精炼、密集-词法混合检索、意图感知的证据选择、交叉编码器重排序，以及“回答 / 相关但不匹配 / 无答案”的三分类决策机制。在210条带URL标注的阿拉伯语和英语查询上，与混合基线相比，所提出的方法将Top-1命中率从50.48%提升至79.05%，MRR@5从0.571提升至0.797。此外，在另一项包含26个案例的端到端评估中达到了69.2%的准确率。
tldr: 本文提出一种完全本地化部署的证据门控双语RAG框架，通过结构化内容精炼、混合检索、意图感知证据选择、重排序和三分类决策机制，将消费银行搜索的Top-1命中率从50.48%提升至79.05%，并有效支持阿拉伯语与英语的双语查询。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a fully local, evidence-gated bilingual RAG framework that combines structured content refinement, hybrid retrieval, intent-aware evidence selection, cross-encoder reranking, and a three-outcome decision mechanism, improving consumer banking search Top-1 hit rate from 50.48% to 79.05% across Arabic and English queries.
